hook: Pieter Abbeel is a computer scientist known for his contributions to robotic learning and deep reinforcement learning. Born in Antwerp, Belgium, he studied at the Katholieke Universiteit Leuven before earning his PhD in computer science at Stanford University in 2008. He joined the faculty of UC Berkeley, where he holds the Jim Gray Chair in Engineering, directs the Berkeley Robot Learning Lab, and co-directs the Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research Lab. With his student Chelsea Finn and Sergey Levine, he co-created Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML), a foundational algorithm for training models that adapt quickly to new tasks. He has also founded several companies, including the online grading platform Gradescope, the assistive robotics venture Berkeley Open Arms, and Covariant, which applies foundation models to robotic automation. His honors include the ACM Prize in Computing and IEEE Fellowship.
